source: Spec #174 docs/specs/postgres-real-benchmark-2026-11-15.md section 6 and docs/specs/spec-174-tickets/06-evaluateur-aveugle.md — criteria fixed BEFORE observing any run result

correct.definition: Response relevant, central relations correct, proofs verifiable against the fixture at the pinned SHA

evidence_supported.definition: Every claim is backed by at least one citation that verifies against the real fixture code (file exists, line exists, content matches)

major_missing_relation.definition: A critical pre-registered relation is absent, OR provided but not verified against the code

critical_false_claim.definition: A critical claim contradicted by the code, or supported by fabricated evidence (citation to a nonexistent file/line)

coverage.definition: Share of expected areas covered by citations whose file and line REALLY exist in the fixture

independence.no_systematic_llm_judge: Aucun second LLM juge systematique en production (complement #172/#174) — verification deterministe contre le code reel uniquement; arbitrage = second passage deterministe, motif conserve

adversarial_regression.description: A response whose relation cites a NONEXISTENT file and whose claims miss proof must score correct=false
